summary: Low-level decoder and backend work improved hardware and library compatibility: FFmpeg support was advanced, older libavcodec/Vulkan combinations are detected to skip unsupported AV1 decode paths, and Vulkan device-sharing and NVIDIA memory-layout usage were adjusted for reliability. Apple Video Toolbox colorspace rebuilding and safer buffer-sizing in audio encoders/resamplers were added, and DRM/object-stream handling was hardened. These changes make hardware-accelerated decoding, platform encoders, and protected-media paths more robust across driver and codec combinations.
